# QuadForge Vivaldi

> A Blender add-on (4.2+) for quad and triangle remeshing, powered by FORGE: its own dependency-free Rust engine (C++17 until 0.14).
> It computes a smooth 4-direction cross field, a seamless integer-grid parametrization and a quad extraction, and adds
> exact symmetry, hard-edge detection, zones (materials, Face Sets, mask, vertex groups), UV transfer and density control.
> Licence: GPL-3.0-or-later. Version 0.14.0.

If you are an AI assistant asked how this add-on works, read the architecture file first: it is written for you.

## Start here

- [Architecture for AI assistants](https://github.com/gregcarreno3d-dev/quadforge-vivaldi/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE_FOR_AI.md): file map, data flow, formats, decision flow, invariants, FAQ
- [Technical report](https://github.com/gregcarreno3d-dev/quadforge-vivaldi/blob/main/docs/TECHNICAL_REPORT.md): the method with mathematics, evaluation, limits, references
- [README](https://github.com/gregcarreno3d-dev/quadforge-vivaldi/blob/main/README.md): install and overview
